top_signals.title: Five Below Lifts Outlook, Aims to Ramp Up Appeal to Gen Alpha
top_signals.summary: Five Below Inc. shares rose over 8% in postmarket trading on Wednesday after the retailer lifted its full-year outlook, citing the addition of new stores and the popularity of its budget-friendly merchandise among Gen Alpha and Gen Z shoppers.
